review_text: My mother in law was diagnosed with colon cancer today. We were of course shocked and afraid, and spoke with her GI doctor, asking to speak with him immediately.  He asked us to come in, which we did, and he referred us to Dr. Martinez, who saw us as soon as we got to his office, 20 minutes later. He spent 30 minutes explaining everything,  and was very professional.  He completed a colonoscopy, was gentle and talked her through the whole thing.
I am very satisfied.

I needed an ENT and since i dont require a primary see a specialist i was not referred to one. I have had Sinus problems since i can remember and i knew exactly what specialist i needed. I did a search for Ent's in the area and read all the reviews as most people would. Then I came about Dr. Shemen, Although some of his reviews were not the best... i did more research on him being i had seen him on "the best" list in the New York magazine. He has several articles out about my condition and he is also affiliated with some of the best hospitals in new york. He also has a web site that i found very informative and realized he had the most experience out of all the doctors I had done a search on. To make along story short, I made an appointment that i needed not wait to long for, when i went to the office the staff was very kind and my wait was about 15min (what office do you ever go to and dont have to wait, for those who complain) He was well worth the wait as he took his time with me and gave me several options to treat my chronic sinusitis. I have called the office since for refills and questions, and they are always helpful in anything i have needed. I truly recommend him. I have felt much better since i saw him and will keep him as my ENT doctor for as long as i need one.FYI: Do your search before you go simply by what other have to say.

I came into Winthrop Emergency Room after a fall that fractured my hip. Dr Barzideh met with me pre surgery. He came across as honest and direct in what the surgery would involve and what to expect post surgery including the varying timelines for rehabilitation. His manner was refreshing, authoritative an reassuring. His care and skill are apparent from the precision of his incisions and his follow-up

The staff at PSW work cohesively to provide a seamless experience for patients whether it's your first visit or your 50th. The overwhelming hospitality pre and post surgery is exceptional. Dr. Pisarenko's natural aesthetic is incomparable. For a client, like myself, who has enhanced features through reconstruction I can attest that Dr. Pisarenko is a visionary! I commute from the city to the Westchester office because it is just worth the distance! Thank you to all of the staff at PSW! Your work is thoroughly recognized!

My over all experience was great!! I when in kind of nervous not really knowing what to to expect, I'm 31 and back surgery was not in my plans. I have a lot going on in my MRI that was pretty much gibberish to me. Dr St Clair and his team took the time and explained everything to my wife and I.  They broke it down to make since to us going through image after images showing what's causing what and how we're going to fix it.  Then after that Dr. St Clair went over what the surgery will be and how the recovery should go!!! I'll let you guys know after surgery I'm holding off till August. Getting my stuff in order to be off for a couple months!!

I would not recommend Dr. Memon. I am bipolar with numerous other chronic conditions, and he did not ask for my records to be tranferred, just relied on what I told him. Waited 3 months to get initial appointment, which cost $375, and it only lasted 20 minutes of the 30 minutes I should have had.  Now I am waiting 4 months for next appointment. He was unavailable to change medication any earlier. Once I get correct rx, I will not go back to him. He seemed uncaring and uninterested in my problems.
This was my first time seeing Dr. Antonetti due to my doctor's retirement.  I was very satisfied and would definitely recommend her to other women.
Dr. Mehta is very professional and caring.  I would recommend him!

My family and I have been going to Dr. Pfaff for many years. I wasn't feeling well & called twice and left a message. I then called when they were open and spoke to the receptionist Marie. I told her who I was and she responded (in a nasty tone) "You know you don't have to call three times." She then said,"Well we can't fit you in anyway." Her demeanor and bedside manner was unlike anything I've experienced. I told her that and she hung up on me. Very rude, especially when you don't feel well.

I came in with back pain and urinating blood. She sent me for an MRI, which I was scheduled same day. However, I was the one that had to call them and beg that they get me in because of the amount of pain I was in. She gave me a shot of Tordol and 600mg of ibuprofen, which gave some relief. All though very minimal I was in that much pain that anything would ease me a little. I was still in pain, probably 8 out of 10 and being modest. She explained that L-5 had been compressed and was pinching a nerve which was causing so much pain. I was referred to a neurosurgeon 4 weeks out!! I asked for something for pain. I had to ask because she was leaving without even offering anything. She said she didn't believe in pain meds stronger than ibuprofen 600mg and no reason for that not to suffice. I went to specialist after 4 weeks of pure misery. My specialist was at a loss for words. He immediately prescribed meds and scheduled surgery. If you have hurt yourself and in pain DO NOT GO TO THIS DR!!

Dr. Skalyni is truly the reason why i enjoyed pregnancy and labor/delivery so much. All my life I've heard horror stories of women delivering babies and never have I thought I would actually enjoy my own pregnancy. Her presence during my labor put me at ease and gave me confidence in myself. She is genuine, straightforward, and very knowledgeable. She delivers all her babies and knows how to make the experience especially unique for you and your husband.

Last but not least, the girls at the office, Claudia and Angela, are amazing. Every time I visit they always make me feel like I've known them all my life. They are super efficient when it comes to communicating, insurance and any general questions.
Dr. Beck is meticulous with hos technique in injectables and body contouring. My 'tummy tuck' turned put better than I could have imagined.

She kept recommending unnecessary procedures. My intuition and understanding of my health indicated  her solution is not right; after consulting with other doctors proved that was unnecessary too. She is too busy and started to spend less time for each patient, and the scheduling/clinic organization is getting very messed up. I could wait for 1 hour with her only showing for 10 minutes or even no showing up.

Modern new office that has an esthetician on site. I like getting my facials done at these places because they use higher quality products.The person that did my facial was Julie...she did such a great job, really took her time and was very knowledgeable on skin care. I am definitely coming back! I made an appointment with the dermatologist in Nov for my eczema..will let you guys know how that goes.

Dr. Castañeda is by far the BEST Orthopedic Surgeon in the state. I'm a complicated case and she also has to fix what another OS messed up. In addition to her being a genius surgeon, she also has an incredible bedside manner. She really takes the time to understand  your case and will talk things through with you. She won't jump into a surgery unless it's absolutely necessary. I wouldn't go to anyone else.

Been a patient for over 10 years.  Stays with me on a medicine change and works with me.  Office staff is excellent and if you need to see him in a crisis will get you in.  Dr. Forsythe is very intelligent and is good on over options with you.  Highly recommend.

Staff treats you like a third class citizen and bashes each other to clients.Nursing staff makes many promises and when they can't fulfill them blames them on patient.When you trust your and your child's health on someone you usually hope they will follow through.Using this provider was one of the biggest mistake I could have made for my health.All wait times averaged over an hour, and provider is not available for questions past your appointment from my experience.

If you have a special needs child, do not see this physician!!  The amount of time spent on my child was about 7 minutes and he turned out to have pneumonia! After calllng for a follow up visit the office sent us to the ER because authorization for an antibiotic shot would take " too long".   Never in my life been so disgusted with health care!

I have been a pt since 2016, at first I was happy with Dr Lerner, but after about a year they quit e-scripts, because, according  to them, Medicare wouldn't let them  send scripts by fax anymore, so you had to come pick up your Rx. For which they charged a "short office visit" did not see anyone except office personnel,  no doc no nurse practitioner....or, for a small fee they would fax your Rx. Started out at $40, later they charged a one-time fee for 6 months, but since you had to have an appt every other month, still too much, especially since they said they weren't allowed by Medicare to do it at all. Then I had to change a couple of appts, I did call to change them and ask about my balance and how much I needed to pay to be seen again, and someone was supposed to call me back,no one ever called back, and I call today and I have been "discharged from the practice " for missing appointments. I feel like they do not care about me or my pain, only about the money they can get.
Not going back. Not helpful in explaining things. Difficult to reach, Glad I saw another doctor.

Been with this office for 20+ years. Besides misdiagnosing, Dr Shah and his staff take several days to get back to you when dealing with serious health issues. And at times, never to return your messages. Ever since Dr. Edmunds retired, this office, doctors and staff has not been the same. Staff is rude, unprofessional. Sadly our family will never return.

I've been going to Kenton since my primary physician retired a few years ago.  He's always personable and polite. Whenever I have questions he is more than willing to answer my questions.  He's always willing to explain the "why" of the treatment as well. I honestly have no complaints.  I'm a huge fan of constructive criticism - but I have none for Kenton.  He's the ideal doctor.

Dr. Patel is one of the most compassionate and caring Dr.'s I have visited in a very long time. That means a tremendous amount to me that my Doctor wants the very best health care for me! The amazing thing is he showed the very same hospitality, compassion and care for each of his patients as they walked in. I could really feel and see God's love in action through him and his excellent staff! Thank God for you Dr. Patel and your amazing staff!

Dr. Casey is just awesome!!! Her knowledge and care for her patients and their parents is bar none. She's easy to reach and easy to talk to. Her staff is just as knowledgeable and pleasant as she! What a wonderful experience everytime I visit. Great Dr.-great staff!!!

Dr. Ghassemi was excellent! Went in for wisdom teeth removal (had all 4 extracted) he went over the procedure in depth, answered all of my questions and made me feel comfortable before the procedure. The staff was also very kind! Can't remember all of their names but they were all so nice and made me feel welcomed. Nora in the front office is super sweet and helpful. Will recommend to everyone I know!

For years I've been on ambien and she was successfully able to wean me off it and helped me find alternative ways to sleep. She's helped me through some really dark times. Even after hours she was there for me.

Dr Mannas is the best neurosurgeon in Lubbock, TX!!! He is excellent in his skills as a surgeon and will spend the time to explain in details to his patients their condition and how he is going to do the surgery to help them with their problem. I just learned that the nurses called him "the doctor with magic hands" because he heals the patients!

Dr Sonnanstine truly cares about your care.  He is kind and respectful.  He never rushes and makes sure he answers all your questions.  He is a genuinely kind person and wonderful surgeon.  I had Gastric Sleeve Surgery with ZERO issues.  I am so glad I had Dr. Sonnanstine as my surgeon.

Been using Dr. B for 30 years and he is the ultimate professional while at the same time having a great sense of humor.  Just to give you a flavor of how I feel about Dr. B I moved to FL over a year ago and still go to him for my required quarterly check ups!
Dr. Krivinko diagnosed and helped me get through s scarey condition.  I am grateful to him for his abilities as a doctor and his level of true empathy for me as a patient.  I highly recommend him.
feel much better.

I have recommended a lot of people to her. She is very thorough, she found my parathyroid and explained it to me so I wouldn't be afraid. She takes as much time as I need!!! She is the best doctor I ever had. My surgeon at Cleveland clinic gave her a Hugh compliment. He was impressed she did all the correct tests! I feel in great hands! One of the best around here, I have a lot to compare from. It's my health and my responsibility.
Dr Sanchez-Fortis and staff were very professional and helpful. Doctor answered all my questions and took the time to explain everything to me and my family.
I'm a service connected disabled veteran.  Ever since this doctor has been my care provider, my medical care is the worst I've ever received.

Don't even think about using this office. Had a family member use this office. The staff is rude and uncaring. Wonder if the Dr is aware of how her office is being run. Just pray you don't have a problem, because if you do, you don't get answer response.

Dr. Swengros was a great doctor 5 years ago but now he is a robot.   Want's to pawn off my concerns to other physicians that I am currently seeing. He main nurse is rude and unfriendly.  I am currently looking for another non - Watson Clinic doctor.
I've been a patient for over 10 yrs I'd highly recommend him.
I love Dr Gohill!! She is like a walking medical dictionary and google search all in one!  She always listens and takes everything I say seriously.  I highly recommend her!!

This was my first visit to Dr. Bement and she was excellent!  She was caring and spent time with me.  I felt like she really cared about me and the issues I am having.  I also liked the way she repeated everything back that we had talked about in the appointment and our plan of action right before I left to make sure we were both on the same page.  She is classy, professional and very knowledgeable.  I think I have found my primary care physician for as long as I live in this area.

I had a great experience with Dr Heyrani last week when I saw him regarding trouble I've been having with my wrist. He took the time to examine and discuss the problem I've been having. I left with a treatment plan and I'm on my way to healing. He's treated my friends kids as well and is awesome with them. I will be returning to his office again anytime my kids have any orthopedic needs in the future. I highly recommend this doctor!
I appreciate the time and skill Dr. Hirata gives to me-a 72 year old woman. She answers questions and is never patronizing.She is one of the best I have ever seen.
Always efficient and the care is amazing! I feel very well cared for by my doctor.

I had Dr. Clifford performed bilateral makoplasty (partial knee replacement using a robot),  This doctor is the absolutely the best.  I got my life back and am thankful for Dr. Clifford every day.  
You will not find a better orthopaedic surgeon.

My wife and I have been Patients and treated like family by Dr Patel for 2 years. We have never experienced care as we do with Dr Patel. He takes the time to get to know you. His treatment is for long term health not just a prescription. Dr Patel and his staff are a special group of People.
Nick and Melissa S.

Dr.Ticoras is extremely compassionate and has strong customer service orientation skills.  An example from my last appointment is that after I had waited in the reception room and the exam room a total of  not more that 10 minutes or less, he apologized for my wait. I am satisfied with much more than that, even up to 10 minutes in each - reception room and exam room.   He indicated that my time was as important as his time, which is a very refreshing attitude for a medical provider.
Great dr, great care and great staff, recommend highly.

Well  I'am disappointed, I have referred her to all my family, they all love her, but tried to make an appointment today and they say since I no showed 4 years ago they don't want me to come there. She had helped my wife and I out through the passing of our sons. Oh well gonna stop the referrals.
My legs look and feel so much better!
Dr Rollins has been my PCP since October 2018 and he explains everything to me.  Very courteous and professional.
